about_the_game:
MEOWDAY, MEOWDAY! REMOTE OPERATORS, WE NEED YOU!

Citadrill is recruiting ambitious self-starters to become remote operators! Tired of your office job? Boss got you punching the wall? Then come, shepherd a giant drill in an exciting and dynamic workplace called the ✨abyss✨. Drill for resources, build weapons, and decide how to allocate materials. Every decision will count as you manage your cat-izens, explore hazardous environments, and fight off monsters. Don't fret if one expedition ends in disaster - we can always just send you out on another. 

BUILD AND IMPROVE YOUR CITY WHILE MINING DEEPER AND DEEPER.

You'll be in charge of building what your workers need and acquiring what's necessary for the drill's survival. Plop buildings down in your moving settlement, assign workers to stations, and create a flourishing, efficient Citadrill with lots of happy productive workers and big guns. And while you're at it, collect new blueprints along the way to make the most of your build. 

EXPLORE AND WEAR LOTS OF HATS 

Brave the unknown for resources while keeping your drill intact and crew alive. Adjust your course and strategy in different biomes, each with its own set of challenges and rewards. Standout candidates are those with experience being ｓｔｒｅｃｈｅｄ, s͎q͎u͎i͎s͎h͎e͎d͎, on🔥fire, f͓̽r͓̽o͓̽z͓̽e͓̽n͓̽ or ░g░a░s░s░y░. Bonus points for working well under pressure. 

SURVIVE… AND TRAUMA BOND WITH CAT COWORKERS!

Many underground monsters are…unfriendly, to put it lightly. But! We believe the right remote operator can tackle the challenge of going toe-to-toe with colossal citapedes, refusing to back down when faced with endless hordes of deep denizens, or hazardous environments. And you won't be alone! C.A.T. is a dependable Drill O.S. (and supervisor) who will accompany you through any number of horrors daily tasks and trials. 

  ⚠️//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////⚠️

SALARY AND BENEFITS ARE NON-TRANSFERABLE UPON EMPLOYEE TERMINATION, INCINERATION, FUMIGATION, OR COMPRESSION. ONLY THE UTTERLY UNQUALIFIED SHOULD APPLY.

  ⚠️//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////⚠️

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5Ghz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution and dedicated graphics card with 1GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)

short_description: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.
